preregistration.hypothesis: A direct synchronous function can return a BytesView uniquely derived from exactly one borrowed BytesView parameter, preserving one root Bytes owner and transferring the borrow into the caller without surface lifetime syntax, allocation, payload copy, reference counting, or a new owner.
preregistration.stop_condition: Return BYTES_BORROWED_RETURN_INCOMPLETE without implementing a general lifetime solver if the restricted proof is insufficient.

scope.supported: immutable BytesView borrowed returns through direct synchronous chains of at most two borrowed-return functions

controls: Freeze exact status gates before implementation.
Require one borrowed source parameter and reject ambiguity with AmbiguousBorrowReturnOrigin.
Validate root parent child caller last-use identities in versioned HIR and MIR manifests.
Run an intentionally copying or wrong-origin falsification control through the structural auditor.
Compare surface HIR unoptimized MIR optimized MIR and native results.
Use ASan UBSan and LeakSanitizer only on actually executed native binaries.
Run one Decision corpus and one full tests invocation after rapid checks stabilize.
Freeze previous artifact hashes and do not rerun prior benchmarks.
self_skeptical_audit.name: SELF_SKEPTICAL_AUDIT
self_skeptical_audit.post_hoc_status: Status and every support gate remain fixed until final artifact validation.
threats: Origin inference may accidentally accept a syntactically named parameter while the returned descriptor comes from another root.
Line-based last-use analysis may end a transferred borrow before a nested expression or one control-flow branch finishes.
A two-function return chain may erase the original root identity or leave an unmatched parent transfer.
MIR optimization may inline calls and delete marker-only instructions even when their ordering is semantically required.
Generated C may copy payload data even if interpreter counters remain zero.
Descriptor equality alone is insufficient; pointer offset and nested range containment must be checked.
Compile-time rejects must not be counted as sanitizer executions.
A denominator built from repeated source text would overstate independent coverage.
Existing reborrow evidence cannot substitute for borrowed-return evidence.
Post-hoc weakening of status gates would invalidate the experiment.
